name: loose-baseline
label: Loose Baseline
profile: shipped baseline + 4c requote deadband (second-round tweak: was 6c)
desc: Control. Shipped loose baseline with the deadband tightened to 4c after the #938 interim read: 6c holds the resting leg stale while live books run.
thesis: The shipped defaults are the reference: any arm must beat this to earn a change.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 27 exits on 53 closes; pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 23 (-$14.72), worst market nba-uta-nop -5.01 on 6 closes. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.04 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: repricing the resting leg at 4c instead of 6c fills leg two before the book runs; if exits persist, staleness is not the mechanism.

name: tight-touch
label: Tight Touch
profile: balanced preset 0.50x + 3c floor (second-round tweak: min was preset 2c)
desc: Balanced 0.50x offset with the floor lifted to 3c: cheaper first fills leave room under the cap for the hedge.
thesis: A first fill one cent cheaper is a hedge that still fits under $0.99.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 25 exits on 53 closes; pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 21 (-$15.95), worst market nba-uta-nop -5.91 on 6 closes. Applied BOT_QUOTE_SPREAD_OFFSET_MIN_CENTS=3 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: standing 3c off the touch fills leg one cheaper, leaving cap room for leg two; if orphans persist, entry price is not the mechanism.

name: balanced-mid
label: Balanced Mid
profile: balanced preset 0.50x + 5c ceiling + 6c deadband (second-round tweak: ceiling was preset 4c)
desc: The middle preset with the tracking ceiling lifted to 5c: quotes stand further off in volatility instead of filling rich.
thesis: In swings the cushion matters more than the fill: a 5c ceiling fills first legs cheaper than the 4c clamp.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 26 exits on 51 closes; pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 21 (-$11.77), worst market nba-uta-nop -4.26 on 7 closes. Applied BOT_QUOTE_SPREAD_OFFSET_MAX_CENTS=5 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 5c ceiling keeps first fills cheap enough to hedge; if orphans persist, tracking width is not the mechanism.

name: wide-shield
label: Wide Shield
profile: conservative preset 0.75x / 2-5c + 6c absolute stop (second-round tweak: was 5c)
desc: Widest preset offset with the stop widened to 6c: the 5c stop fired on noise 30 times.
thesis: A stop that fires on noise is a fee; 6c keeps the tail cut while letting legs survive spread noise.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 36 exits on 50 closes; lifecycle_hard_stop 30 (-$16.10), only 14 merges, worst market nhl-ott-buf -2.45 on 2 closes. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.060 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 6c fires on genuine breaks instead of noise; falsified if the worst single grows past -$2.

name: prudent-hybrid
label: Prudent Hybrid
profile: prudent preset 0.60x + 5c ceiling + 6c deadband (second-round tweak: ceiling was 6c)
desc: The hybrid preset with the 6c excursion pulled back to 5c: the 6c clamp parks quotes where the hedge has already run.
thesis: A 0.60x multiplier is the compromise: enough cushion for swings, close enough to fill — and no 6c excursions.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 26 exits on 50 closes; pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 24 (-$15.92, worst count), worst market nba-uta-nop -5.30 on 7 closes. Applied BOT_QUOTE_SPREAD_OFFSET_MAX_CENTS=5 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: capping the tracked excursion at 5c keeps pairs close enough to complete; if orphans persist, excursion depth is not the mechanism.

name: static-floor-2c
label: Dynamic Offset On
profile: dynamic offset ON + 6c ceiling (second-round tweak: ceiling was unbounded 20c)
desc: Volatility tracking switched on, now with a 6c ceiling: unbounded tracking whipsawed 124 lifecycle cancels yet still stranded legs.
thesis: Tracking with a leash prices volatile books wider without parking quotes a book-move away.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 25 exits on 49 closes; lifecycle_cancel 124 on 296 orders, pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 22 (-$12.62), worst market nba-uta-nop -5.41 on 6 closes. Applied BOT_QUOTE_SPREAD_OFFSET_MAX_CENTS=6 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 6c ceiling keeps tracking contained so fills stay hedgeable; if orphans persist, tracking itself is not the mechanism.

name: low-churn-deadband
label: Low Churn Deadband
profile: static 2c + 4c requote dead band (second-round tweak: was 6c)
desc: Static 2c offset with the deadband tightened to 4c: the stalest combination in the field held quotes through live moves.
thesis: Churn is the cost, but a stale static quote is the loss: reprice before the book leaves it behind.
worst_catalyst: Static 2c + 6c deadband (#938): orphan exits 50.0% (27/54), worst total
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 27 exits on 54 closes; pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 22 (-$17.08), worst market nba-uta-nop -9.57 on 5 closes. Applied BOT_ORDER_REQUOTE_DEAD_BAND_USD=0.04 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 4c reprices a static quote before a live move strands it; if exits persist, the static floor itself is the mechanism.

name: hair-trigger-2c
label: Hair Trigger 5.5c
profile: 5.5c absolute stop on a naked leg (second-round tweak: was 4.5c)
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 5.5c: the 4.5c stop still fired on everything, 42 exits against 6 merges.
thesis: A naked leg is an unchosen bet; 5.5c continues the 2c-to-4.5c ladder toward firing on real moves only.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 42 exits on 48 closes; lifecycle_hard_stop 36 (-$13.79), only 6 merges, worst market nhl-ott-buf -2.45 on 2 closes. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.055 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 5.5c lets more legs survive to merge; falsified if merge count stays flat or the worst single grows past -$2.

name: patient-stop-9c
label: Patient Stop 7c
profile: 7c absolute stop on a naked leg (second-round tweak: was 6c)
desc: Single-leg stop armed at 7c: the midpoint between the never-fires 9c and the hair-trigger 6c.
thesis: Most 2-6c drops are noise a hedge can still recover; a 7c stop only cuts legs that truly broke.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 36 exits on 48 closes; lifecycle_hard_stop 28 (-$15.85) plus 162 lifecycle cancels, worst market nhl-ott-buf -2.45 on 2 closes. Applied BOT_RISK_STOP_ADVERSE_DROP_USD=0.070 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: 7c keeps the stop a circuit breaker instead of an exit factory; falsified if hard-stop exits stay above two-thirds of closes.

name: queue-clear-5m
label: Queue Clear 2m
profile: queue-clear gate on, 2-minute max clear (second-round tweak: was 3m)
desc: Only quotes books whose queue is likely to clear inside two minutes: the best exit shape in the field, but tails still reach -$4.70.
thesis: A quote stuck behind a slow queue is dead capital; a faster window refuses the books whose queue clears into a runaway.
worst_catalyst_desc: From #938 interim shadow read: 22 exits on 45 closes (best shape, 23 merges); pair_cap_hedge_unreachable 15 (-$11.81), worst market nba-uta-nop -4.67 on 6 closes. Applied BOT_ORDER_QUEUE_MAX_CLEAR_MIN=2 for #940.
tweak_rationale: Hypothesis: a 2-minute window refuses drifting books; quote count falls but quality per quote rises.
